title: Aviation User Checklist

nodes.text: Check Pilot/Aircraft Data Card—Approved and current for aircraft type, contract, and mission

evidence.source_text: Pilot/Aircraft Data Card—Approved and current for aircraft type, contract, and mission?

nodes.text: Initiate and confirm Flight Plan/Flight Following with agency/bureau

evidence.source_text: Flight Plan/Flight Following—Initiated and confirmed with agency/bureau?

nodes.text: Ensure PPE is available and worn by all passengers and pilot as required for the mission

evidence.source_text: PPE—Available and worn by all passengers and pilot as required for the mission?

nodes.text: Brief pilot on mission objectives, flight route, known flight hazards, and aerial hazard map

evidence.source_text: Pilot briefed on mission objectives, flight route, known flight hazards, and aerial hazard map?

nodes.text: Provide pilot or flight manager safety briefing to passengers

evidence.source_text: Pilot or flight manager safety briefing provided to passengers?

nodes.text: Include in safety briefing: Aircraft hazards, Seatbelt or harness, Fuel and electrical shutoff, ELT and survival kit, Oxygen (if applicable), First aid kit, Gear and cargo storage, Emergency seating position, Emergency exit(s), Fire extinguisher, No smoking
